targetChange: Switched from the predeclared Zod candidate to toss/es-toolkit before any analysis ran (single-package Vitest + Yarn layout with colocated src/**/*.spec.ts made historical checkouts cheap to drive). No Zod analysis was run.
licenseCheck: LICENSE contains the MIT License text at all 72 candidate merge SHAs before the cutoff.
selection: Latest 25 consecutive eligible merged PRs before cutoff (newest first by mergedAt from gh pr list --limit 80); every considered PR and exclusion reason is published in results/es-toolkit.json.
eligibility: At least one changed executable source line under src/ remains after review-core parseDiff exclusions (tests, fixtures, .d.ts, comments, imports, type-only lines)
eligibilityNotApplied: The full unmodified suite was not run separately; Stryker's initial test run over Vitest-related tests is the baseline and must pass
scope: Merge/squash commit M vs first parent M^, changed executable source lines only, tests as merged at M; never present-day tests against historical code
operators: StrykerJS 10.1.1 default mutators with @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner 10.1.1, coverageAnalysis perTest

limitsApplied.note: The predeclared file/line/mutant/300 s limits were not enforced in this run; the largest PR (#2097: 50 files, 621 lines, 637 mutants, 190 s) exceeds them.

humanReview: Not done. Only the four example survivors quoted in RESULTS.md were read against the merged source and spec; reviewed-sample precision is unavailable.
conclusion: 11 of 25 completed analyses of merged es-toolkit PRs had at least one changed-line mutant that the PR's merged test suite did not detect (178 Survived, 116 NoCoverage across 1,057 changed-line mutants; median changed-line score 93.5% over the 20 PRs with mutants). 5 completed PRs produced no mutants and count as no gap. Changed-line scoping instrumented 1,057 of 4,088 whole-file mutants (74.1% avoided, counted not executed). Survivors are untested behaviour changes, not proven bugs; equivalent mutants are included and were not filtered. No token, dollar, energy or carbon savings are claimed, and nothing implies the historical tests were AI-generated.
